summary: Backend regression for new BidBlitz Super-App modules: Insurance (Quote Calculator + Products + Claims + Admin Review) & Telemedizin (Slots, Booking, Cancel, Prescriptions). 28/28 pytest tests passed against the public preview URL using cookie-based auth (admin@bidblitz.com + freshly-registered TEST_user_*). Wallet topped up via direct Mongo write to enable purchase flow. Reservation_system.py confirmed removed and not imported.

minor.issue: No /api/health endpoint exists. Used /api/insurance/categories as smoke check. Consider adding a real health endpoint.
Returns 404 ("Schaden nicht gefunden") when a different user requests a claim. Functionally fine, but 403 Forbidden would be more REST-correct than masking ownership as not-found.

ObjectId.is_valid check uses ternary on _id; fine for current users but the fallback {'_id': c['user_id']} (a string) will never match in MongoDB. Acceptable since user_id is always derived from str(ObjectId).

action_items: (Optional) Add a real /api/health endpoint for monitoring
(Optional) Return 403 instead of 404 when a user requests another user's claim (consistency with /api/telemedizin/cancel which returns 403)
critical_code_review_comments: routes/insurance.py: Wallet credit on payout uses ObjectId conversion correctly via ObjectId.is_valid — safe.
routes/insurance.py: Purchase flow guards balance with conditional update_one ($gte) — race-safe.
routes/telemedizin.py: Slot booking has no DB-level uniqueness on (doctor_id,date,time); two simultaneous bookings of the same slot would both succeed. Consider unique index for production.
routes/telemedizin.py: /prescription does not verify that the doctor owns the appointment (any admin/doctor can issue Rx for any appointment). Acceptable for MVP, harden later.
Insurance product seed currently empty in DB — frontend lists will be empty until admin creates products via /api/insurance/products.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@bidblitz.com / BidBlitz2026! (works). Test user registered fresh per-run (TEST_user_<hex>@bidblitz.com).
seed_data_creation: 1 insurance product (TEST_AutoBasis, auto, €25/mo) created via admin POST /api/insurance/products if list was empty. 2 telemedizin appointments booked under doc_001 (2026-02-20 + 2026-02-21). 1 claim filed + reviewed (paid €50). User wallet credited via Mongo for purchase test. Test user is left in DB with balance after refund/payout — safe to ignore.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_insurance_telemedizin.py is a stable regression suite. It registers a fresh test user every run (no collisions) and uses direct Mongo write to top-up balance (no admin-credit endpoint exists). Reuses pytest.shared_* attributes to pass IDs between tests in order. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_insurance_telemedizin.py -v
rca of the issue: N/A — all features under test work as specified. No bugs found.
